audience: shops, logistics teams and sales teams that check customer addresses with Smarty

useCases.title: Verify a US address before shipping
useCases.text: Check one US address against USPS reference data. Get the standard form, the ZIP+4 code and the delivery match codes.

useCases.title: Verify an address outside the US
useCases.text: Check one address outside the US and get its standard form and match status. Use the US address tool for US addresses.

useCases.title: Find the valid ZIP Codes of a city
useCases.text: Look up the valid city, state and ZIP Code combinations for a city and state. Or confirm one ZIP Code.

useCases.title: Find addresses near a map point
useCases.text: Find the US street addresses near a latitude and longitude. Get the census tract and block of one address from the list.

useCases.title: Research a US property and its units
useCases.text: Read the property and assessment data of one US address, when the Smarty account includes it. List the units of a building, such as apartments or suites.
